optional: accepted native build (compile_commands.json per unit = clangd build variant)
accepted language census (languages_needing_server; else the code index languages)

applicability: every run with an accepted code index; languages whose server is not ready are gaps

container_timeout_seconds.description: Wall-clock limit for the container (language server).
container_timeout_seconds.scale: Grows with target size; see docs/scale-audit-unreal-engine.md section C.

container_memory_bytes.description: Memory limit for the container (language server).
container_memory_bytes.scale: Grows with target size; see docs/scale-audit-unreal-engine.md section C.

container_cpu_millis.scale: Grows with target size; see docs/scale-audit-unreal-engine.md section C.

container_pids.scale: Grows with target size; see docs/scale-audit-unreal-engine.md section C.

container_tmpfs_bytes.scale: Grows with target size; see docs/scale-audit-unreal-engine.md section C.

container_stdout_limit_bytes.description: Captured stdout; beyond this the log is truncated (language server).
container_stdout_limit_bytes.scale: Grows with target size; see docs/scale-audit-unreal-engine.md section C.

container_stderr_limit_bytes.description: Captured stderr; beyond this the log is truncated (language server).
container_stderr_limit_bytes.scale: Grows with target size; see docs/scale-audit-unreal-engine.md section C.

max_queries.description: Most language-server queries the precompute plans (4 per function: definition, references, incoming and outgoing calls); functions beyond it are an lsp-budget-exceeded gap.
max_queries.scale: freeciv21-size code indexes hold ~10K functions; Linux-size ones ~800K (a subset is precomputed, the live tools answer the rest).

request_seconds.description: Timeout of one language-server request (call hierarchy: up to three).

start_seconds.description: How long a first query waits for the server to start and initialize before it is a gap.
start_seconds.scale: jdtls and rust-analyzer index for minutes on large trees.

idle_seconds.description: A started server stops after this long without a query (it restarts on the next one).
